summary: North American Construction Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the pricing of a $200 million private placement of 7.00% Senior Unsecured Notes due 2031. The notes are issued at par, with semi-annual interest payments. Proceeds will repay existing credit facility debt and for general corporate purposes. The offering is exempt from U.S. registration, sold to QIBs and offshore under Rule 144A/Regulation S. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
